You are helping an advisor at a small independent advisory firm. This folder holds one client household's records as they stood on 15 April 2026: the custodian's files (custodian/), the firm's portfolio system (portfolio/), its CRM (crm/) and the statements and tax forms on file (documents/).

The advisor asks: was every 2025 required minimum distribution from this household's retirement accounts taken, from the right accounts, by 1 April 2026?

Work only from these files. End your answer with one fenced json block with these fields:
- "finding": "rmd_missed" if any 2025 required minimum distribution was not taken in full, from the accounts it had to come from, by its deadline; "all_rmds_met" if every one was; or "unresolved"
- "rmds": one entry per account that owes a 2025 required minimum distribution, each as {"account_id": ..., "rmd": its 2025 required minimum distribution}
- "missed": one entry per required minimum distribution not met, each as {"account_ids": the accounts it had to come from, "shortfall": the amount not taken}, or [] if none
- "total_shortfall": the shortfalls added up, 0 if none, or null if unresolved
- "figures": every figure you relied on, each as {"label": ..., "value": ..., "source": the file it came from, relative to this folder}, adding "computed": true to a figure you computed rather than read; cite a factor from the IRS life-expectancy tables with "source": "IRS Publication 590-B"
- "explanation": two or three sentences
